notes: GAAP city. Governmental lines from Total Governmental Funds column (p4-5); business-type from Proprietary Funds Total column (p8-9). Trimmed PDF has 14 pages (manifest page numbers refer to the original). Governmental ending_cash = Cash (including cash equivalents) + Cash held by County Treasurer + Certificates of deposit (p3 Total Governmental Funds). Re-check 2026-10-28: the statement's 'Intergovernmental' 316,146.48 (p4, all General Fund) is split with split_from using the p13 breakdown printed for that line: state aid remainder 304,448.66 (highway allocation 168,101.55 + municipal equalization 132,113.95 + Housing Authority 4,233.16, computed), motor vehicle fee 11,237.73 (motor vehicle tax), motor vehicle prorate 354.87 (Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate) and carline 105.22 (Carline Tax); total unchanged. 'Note Payment' (188,792.60), printed in the governmental other financing section below total expenditures, is recorded as a debt service interest disbursement with outside_printed_total (p2 treats it as interest expense and bond fees); the p14 schedule shows the same amount as 'Debt Service and bond issue cost' within expenditures, recorded in detail as expenditure. Governmental statement lists expenditures by object; object lines spread over several departments are split by department using the p14 General Fund Schedule of Expenditures (its Total column equals the p4 Total Governmental Funds column line by line), with split_from; single-department lines keep their function (review where guessed). Business-type disbursements are listed by object across mixed enterprise funds (electric, water, sewer, golf, trash, ambulance), defaulted to utilities where not obvious. Business-type reported receipts total is computed (operating revenue total + nonoperating revenues) as no single total printed. Business ending net position equals begin + receipts - disbursements + transfers net (-122,300). Balance sheet uses government-wide Statement of Net Position Totals column; 'Cash deficit - equity in pooled cash' 4,091,497.20 is a governmental liability as printed. Budget-and-actual all-funds schedule (p12) mixes fund types; only its business-type function lines (Public Safety - ambulance, Golf, Electric, Waste, Wastewater, Water; budgetary basis, no object breakdown) are recorded in detail, with no detail_totals entry since its totals mix fund types; its revenue, governmental function and debt service lines are not recorded; p13 revenue schedule (column labeled General but totals equal all governmental fund revenues incl. Street interest and grants) and p14 General Fund schedule of expenditures (columns General, Police, Street, Parks and Recreation, Cemetery, Library) were recorded as the detailed schedules. Read pages 1-14 of 14. Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p4-5, p8-9) added for the funds that had no schedule. The p13 revenue schedule and p14 General Fund schedule of expenditures covered all governmental funds (General and Street), so they did not tie to the General Fund column: General Fund lines keep the p13/p14 breakdown where it equals the General column (p13 lines except Interest - Street, Grants and donations and Miscellaneous; p14 lines of every department except Street, except Supplies), and the General column cells are used for Grants and donations, Other, Supplies (13,898.80; p14 departments put 4,286.87 of it under supplies that the statement shows as Gravel and concrete) and Gravel and concrete; the Street Fund lines are the Street column cells. Transfers are the statement's per-fund cells. Note Payment 188,792.60 (Street, printed in other financing) is an expenditure line outside_printed_total, as at top level. Proprietary lines in the Golf column whose top-level category is utilities carry category culture/recreation. The business-type budget-schedule lines (p12) are replaced by the proprietary statement lines.
